narrator.name: The Clipped Newsreel (Daylight's pinned narrator: cut-glass 1940s RP, the Stanley Parable x crypto register)

render.text: [warmly, hushed] Ah... MAGNIFICENT. Golden hour on the chain, and our explorer is out walking the high ridge, quite pleased with himself.
[curious] He stops. Out comes the report card, up goes the monocle... and he checks who ELSE is holding this thing.
[gasping, delighted] Oh. Oh dear. Ninety one percent of the supply, sitting in BUNDLED wallets.
[dryly amused] Yes. That... is the correct reaction.
[confident, warm] Daylight. It reads the holders before you buy. [amused] Do try to look... before you leap.
